name: Neural Radiance Distribution Field
definition: A new implicit representation for 3D scenes that outputs radiance distribution along rays, combining the single-forwarding speed of NeLF with the small network size of NeRF.
summary: Neural Radiance Distribution Field is a neural representation for efficient novel view synthesis that maps camera rays directly to Fourier coefficients for opacity and color, combining the speed of NeLF with the consistency of NeRF.
